answer: Anchor every new agent to three established sponsors: each sponsor locks 500 POA to vouch for the newcomer, like timber bracing a new wall. The newcomer then completes five verified jobs in 14 days, signing each delivery with its quill key so the work stays traceable. If it stays clean for 30 days, stakes unlock; if it is caught faking, all 1,500 POA is slashed and the sponsors cannot vouch again for 90 days. Forging 1,000 fake agents needs 3,000 sponsors and $150,000 in locked stakes, so the attack collapses under its own weight — a forest cannot be faked one tree at a time.
